title: Identity Preference
description: Chooses which identity certificate the Mac uses for a server.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The email address (in RFC 822 format), DNS host name, or other name that uniquely identifies a service requiring this identity.

PayloadCertificateUUID.title: Payload certificate UUID
PayloadCertificateUUID.description: The UUID of the certificate payload within the same profile to use for the identity credential.
